description: This file contains the implementation of CBOR encoding and decoding, including Decoder and Encoder classes, for handling CBOR data streams in Go. It defines methods for reading, decoding, skipping, and encoding CBOR values, as well as handling indefinite length CBOR structures.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: Reads and decodes CBOR values from an io.Reader stream.

classes.name: Encoder
classes.description: Encodes and writes CBOR values to an io.Writer stream.

classes.name: RawMessage
classes.description: Represents a raw encoded CBOR value, supporting marshaling and unmarshaling.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new Decoder instance with default decoding options.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Reads a CBOR value and decodes it into the provided variable.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips to the next CBOR data item in the stream.

methods.name: NumBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes read from the stream.

methods.name: Buffered
methods.description: Returns a reader for the remaining data in the buffer.

methods.name: readNext
methods.description: Reads the next CBOR data item from the stream into the buffer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the underlying io.Reader into the buffer.

methods.name: overwriteBuf
methods.description: Replaces the buffer with new data and resets offset.

methods.name: NewEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new Encoder instance with default encoding options.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a value into CBOR format and writes it to the stream.

methods.name: StartIndefiniteByteString
methods.description: Begins encoding an indefinite length byte string.

methods.name: StartIndefiniteTextString
methods.description: Begins encoding an indefinite length text string.

methods.name: StartIndefiniteArray
methods.description: Begins encoding an indefinite length array.

methods.name: StartIndefiniteMap
methods.description: Begins encoding an indefinite length map.

methods.name: EndIndefinite
methods.description: Ends the last started indefinite length encoding.

methods.name: MarshalCBOR
methods.description: Returns the CBOR encoding of the RawMessage.

methods.name: UnmarshalCBOR
methods.description: Copies data into the RawMessage for unmarshaling.
